description: This Java class 'OrderProduct' models an order item in an e-commerce system, tracking product details, quantities, pricing, associated order, and related attributes and downloads.

classes.name: OrderProduct
classes.description: Entity representing a product within an order, including product details, quantities, pricing, and associated attributes and downloads.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order product.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getProductQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: setProductQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates the order with this product.

methods.name: getOrderAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of attributes associated with this order product.

methods.name: setOrderAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attribute collection for this order product.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Returns the set of prices associated with this product.

methods.name: setPrices
methods.description: Sets the price collection for this product.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Returns the set of downloadable items related to this product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU code for the product.

methods.name: setOneTimeCharge
methods.description: Sets the one-time charge amount for the product.
